rating_scale.0: absent or verified broken for required purpose
rating_scale.2: useful basic outcome with substantial verified gaps
rating_scale.3: expected use and important applicable boundary cases work, minor gaps
rating_scale.4: all defined checks satisfied with suitable evidence

criteria.name: Account request to first workspace
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic registration, approval/invite/setup and first useful task; validation/duplicate/inactive-account checks.
criteria.reason: Synthetic request, approval/setup and first-login contracts pass; electrician discovery remains a verified gap (F04).

criteria.name: Field job lifecycle
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic tenant job create, read, edit, notes/material/time, completion/archive/restore; role and persistence checks.
criteria.reason: Job create/reload is browser-verified with linked customer persistence; field suites cover edit, notes, time, resources, archive/recycle/restore and negative roles.

criteria.name: Retail operations
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic order/import/rewards/wholesale contract checks; invalid signatures, replay and store separation.
criteria.reason: Defined synthetic import/reward/wholesale contracts and signature/store/replay cases pass. Real Shopify storefront and provider acceptance are separately unverified in I2.

criteria.name: Shared customer, team and class work
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic customer persistence, team messaging attachments, class enrollment/capacity and handoffs.
criteria.reason: Customer, team channel/attachment, class enrollment/capacity and cross-module server contracts pass in synthetic tests.

criteria.name: Persistence and validation
criteria.acceptance_checks: Reviewed feature tests exercise save/reload and invalid input in representative core tasks.
criteria.reason: Representative feature assertions check persisted records, reload, invalid inputs and ownership; local browser save is independently read from SQLite.

criteria.name: Retry and idempotency
criteria.acceptance_checks: Reviewed duplicate/retry tests for provider events, messages and payments retain one intended result.
criteria.reason: Relevant duplicate event, clock, message, payment and workflow receipt contracts pass after fixture-only environment corrections.

criteria.name: Failures and health visibility
criteria.acceptance_checks: Observe public health and run history/failure contracts; errors must stay distinguishable from success.
criteria.reason: Live readiness works and run-history tests pass, but failed integration-health reads become an apparently factual zero (F05).

criteria.name: Recovery and customer export
criteria.acceptance_checks: Restore a disposable MySQL backup and verify representative customer data export and recovery.
criteria.reason: No disposable MySQL backup/restore or complete customer export-and-recovery rehearsal was performed. Runbooks are not completion evidence.

criteria.name: First value and approval guidance
criteria.acceptance_checks: Visitor understands request vs instant access; synthetic first-login/setup flow identifies useful next action.
criteria.reason: Login/setup and a useful job work; public intake lacks a clear approval-to-first-task explanation and omits electricians (F04/F06).

criteria.name: Navigation and module discovery
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public links and filters work; canonical module visibility and authorized shell navigation have evidence.
criteria.reason: Public controls and catalog filtering work, but header contrast and unsafe/legacy commercial choices materially impair discovery (F01/F03).

criteria.name: Form feedback and recovery
criteria.acceptance_checks: Core invalid/expired/duplicate submissions produce actionable feedback; public controls are usable.
criteria.reason: Defined synthetic validation, expired/invalid auth and form feedback checks pass; keyboard public controls work. This does not assert every form was manually exercised.

criteria.name: Daily home and search
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic role-aware dashboard/search identify available next actions and suppress inaccessible content.
criteria.reason: Defined dashboard, authorized navigation and search contracts pass; empty field workspace provides create-job action and honest disconnected financial state.

criteria.name: Tenant and object boundaries
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic A/B tenant host, membership, object and mobile API negative tests; no real-record enumeration.
criteria.reason: Defined synthetic A/B tenant, host, object, mobile and store negative contracts pass. This is scoped contract evidence, not a universal route audit.

criteria.name: Role and financial boundaries
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic member/manager/owner/landlord and financial-field negative tests for representative workflows.
criteria.reason: Defined owner/admin/member/landlord and financial payload negative cases pass; no customer records were probed in production.

criteria.name: Authentication and session controls
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic login, registration, verification, reset, 2FA and signed/expired-token contracts.
criteria.reason: Synthetic password login/logout/reset/verification/2FA/signed-token tests pass; local browser cookie login succeeds.

criteria.name: Sensitive data and integration gates
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic secret/private-field, unsigned-webhook and disabled-provider/host checks.
criteria.reason: Defined private-field, signed webhook, disabled-provider and host fail-closed cases pass in local tests.

categories.name: Clarity of purpose, audience, and customer value

criteria.name: Purpose, audience and brand
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public platform and parent explain business outcomes; demos are labeled and product families are not falsely conflated.
criteria.reason: The public parent/platform distinction and business outcomes are understandable; industry examples explicitly identify fictional data. Separate products are not falsely assumed integrated.

criteria.name: Prices and package promises
criteria.acceptance_checks: Homepage, plans, start and explorer agree on seat limits, included modules, add-on prices and offer terms.
criteria.reason: Basic prices are visible, but Starter package promises differ and Messaging is priced as the SMS bundle in Explorer (F02).

criteria.name: Availability and next steps
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public discovery suppresses internal/legacy options and distinguishes live, assisted, gated and future capabilities.
criteria.reason: Explorer has useful public filtering and demo disclaimers; plans/intake bypass that filtering and expose internal/legacy/placeholder selections (F03).

criteria.name: Canonical catalog and shared services
criteria.acceptance_checks: Routes/UI reuse centralized module access, navigation and commercial contracts; exceptions are identified.
criteria.reason: Central access/navigation/catalog services exist; separate public commercial payload and first-matching add-on pricing undermine their consistency (F02/F03).

criteria.name: Ownership and domain separation
criteria.acceptance_checks: Representative tenant policies/services/models and provider lanes have explicit ownership without parallel mutations.
criteria.reason: Backend ownership and provider lanes have strong explicit contracts; a demonstrated cross-surface CSS name collision is a maintainability gap (F01).

criteria.name: Documentation and release discipline
criteria.acceptance_checks: Current doc entry points, setup, CI migration/release guards and evidence versioning are coherent and reproducible.
criteria.reason: Protected CI/release and migration practices are substantial; historical/current documentation and setup/test fixtures drift (F06).

criteria.name: Integration contract behavior
criteria.acceptance_checks: Synthetic mocked-provider tests cover signed events, failures, retries and disconnected/disabled state.
criteria.reason: Synthetic provider signature, replay, uncertain-state and disconnect contracts pass. All provider HTTP/mail in the focused DNS checks were faked.

criteria.name: Live sandbox and recovery operations
criteria.acceptance_checks: Verified disposable merchant/store and mailbox sandbox, queue/retry visibility and backup evidence; actual provider acceptance.
criteria.reason: No verified disposable merchant/store, provider mailbox, bank-link device, delivery/queue or restore acceptance environment was supplied or used.

criteria.name: Keyboard, labels and contrast
criteria.acceptance_checks: Public keyboard activation/dialog focus/escape, readable header links and labeled forms have browser evidence.
criteria.reason: Keyboard/dialog behavior works; white navigation links on white background and another measured contrast failure remain (F01).

criteria.name: Responsive public surfaces
criteria.acceptance_checks: Phone 390px, tablet 820px, desktop 1440px checks for core public pages; no horizontal overflow or lost primary CTA.
criteria.reason: Four core public pages in Chromium/WebKit at 390, 820 and 1440 px show no horizontal overflow; primary CTA remains available. Tenant/mobile device coverage is separate.

criteria.name: Representative performance
criteria.acceptance_checks: Record repeatable local browser/Lighthouse timings for representative public routes and note limits; no invented production percentile.
criteria.reason: Local desktop and simulated-mobile measurements were collected, but uncompressed loopback responses and blocked third parties do not establish production performance. Production/device baseline remains unverified.

scope: Production-version source in a disposable local environment plus anonymous public production observation; no authenticated production lifecycle audit.

identifiers.database: disposable SQLite; in-memory for PHP tests, separate file for browser fixtures

evidence_coverage_definition: Weight of assessed rubric criteria, not line/branch/route/automated-test coverage.

gate_assessment.cross_tenant_or_authorization_or_destruc: No triggering defect verified in the defined synthetic checks. Untested production behavior is not declared safe.
gate_assessment.blocked_core_promised_workflow: No total inability verified in the exercised core tasks. Broken public discovery and messaging are recorded, but a working request CTA and synthetic first-value flow remain.

readiness_assessment: Guided-use foundation evidenced; broad launch readiness is not established pending provider, production/device, recovery and commercial clarity validation.

flow_inventory.note: Journey groups, not 1,453 separately executed endpoint lifecycles. VERIFIED WORKING is scoped to its stated local/test steps; PARTIAL includes external acceptance gaps, not necessarily a defect.
